argument: Not publishable as-is. The spine is sound (tier table, flat costs, level gates and the three limitation rules all agree with ch08/ch11/ch12), but four defects block it. Tier 1, must fix. (a) [10-magic-system:65] ends the prerequisites section with a flat denial that any wildcard substitution exists; the Odd ships exactly such an exception for one arcane and one divine ability (ch05:287, ch02:301, ch21:81), and the same absolute already sits at ch08:265. Expected: a carve-out naming the class signature, not deletion of the rule. (b) [10-magic-system:133] gives the worked example's Strong result an extra 15 at the middle of the blast for a card bought at Adept tier, whose row is 6/9/12 (ch10:47); 15 is a Master-row number (ch10:48) and the canon card prints one flat figure for everyone in the radius (ch11:143, ch11:145). Expected: drop the proximity bonus, or restate it as +1 damage tier so it stays inside the budget. (c) [10-magic-system:29] promises casting involves no concentration check, and [10-magic-system:115] then mandates a Fortitude save when a concentrator takes a hit, which the glossary already canonises (ch21:127). Expected: scope line 29 to the casting roll. (d) [10-magic-system:13-15] and [10-magic-system:120] are the third printing of the introduction's set piece: the fire image is word-identical to ch01:210, the never-useless pair also stands at ch05:184, and the spotlight rationale with its lunch-time punchline is ch01:212. Expected: cut the opener to one original sentence and cross-reference ch01. Tier 2, should fix. (e) [10-magic-system:99] lists five arcane Disciplines and line 101 four divine, but the arcane chapter files Plants and Mind cards (ch11:280, ch11:391) and the divine chapter owns a Plants card (ch12:330). Expected: add them or mark the lists illustrative. (f) The column called 'Effect row' at [10-magic-system:45] becomes 'Effect Range' at [10-magic-system:71], and Range is already the card's distance field (ch10:37, ch11:124). Expected: one name, and no reuse of Range for damage. (g) [10-magic-system:55] states the tier-to-row mapping three ways in three sentences, and [10-magic-system:65] repeats the gates just given at [10-magic-system:61]. Expected: one statement of each. Tier 3, polish: seven sentence-initial No-clauses (13, 29, 89, 137), three fragment triplets (81, 97) and three That's-verdict section closers (37, 109, 137, one shared verbatim with ch05:16) read as stock in 138 lines. Verified clean: zero em/en dashes; the worked roll recomputes to the Strong band; Sera matches her ch02 template; goblin DR 0 backs the no-armour claim; costs and gates match ch08:144-146; the signed callout persona is a licensed voice (ch23:68).
